name: Rice
soil: Warm, humid conditions; clay or loamy soil with reliable water.
grow: Transplant healthy seedlings or use direct seeding. Keep early fields moist and level; maintain adequate drainage later.
maintain: Irrigate according to soil and weather. Keep weeds controlled during the first 30–45 days and monitor stem borers, leaf folders and planthoppers.
harvest: Rice is ready when most grains turn hard and straw becomes yellow. Dry harvested grain properly before storage.

name: Wheat
soil: Cool growing season; fertile, well-drained loam is preferred.
grow: Use clean seed and a well-prepared seedbed. Sow at the recommended depth with uniform spacing.
maintain: Give irrigation at critical stages such as crown-root initiation and grain filling. Scout for rust, aphids and weeds.
harvest: Harvest when plants are golden and grains are hard with low moisture.

name: Maize
soil: Warm weather and fertile, well-drained soil with good sunlight.
grow: Sow quality hybrid seed at uniform depth and spacing. Apply nutrients based on soil condition.
maintain: Maintain moisture during knee-high, tasseling and grain-filling stages. Control weeds early and scout for fall armyworm and stem borers.
harvest: Harvest when husks dry and kernels reach physiological maturity.

name: Cotton
soil: Warm climate, long frost-free period and deep, well-drained soil.
grow: Use quality seed and maintain proper plant population. Ensure good drainage after heavy rain.
maintain: Keep fields weed-free early. Monitor bollworms, jassids, whiteflies and sucking pests; irrigate as needed during flowering and boll development.
harvest: Pick fully opened, dry bolls in multiple rounds.

name: Soybean
soil: Warm season crop needing well-drained soil; avoid prolonged waterlogging.
grow: Use treated, quality seed and sow with suitable row spacing after dependable monsoon rainfall.
maintain: Maintain drainage, manage weeds during the first 30–40 days and monitor girdle beetle, defoliators and pod pests.
harvest: Harvest when leaves fall and pods turn brown; avoid over-drying before threshing.

name: Groundnut
soil: Sandy loam or light, friable soil that allows peg and pod development.
grow: Use quality seed and a fine seedbed. Maintain uniform plant stand and adequate calcium near pod development.
maintain: Keep soil loose and weed-free during early growth. Avoid waterlogging and monitor leaf spot, rust and sucking pests.
harvest: Harvest when most pods are mature and inside shells are darkened appropriately.

name: Chickpea
soil: Cool, dry weather; well-drained loam to black soil.
grow: Sow treated seed in moist soil with good spacing. Avoid excessive nitrogen.
maintain: Irrigate only when needed, especially around branching and pod filling. Scout for pod borer and wilt.
harvest: Harvest when plants dry and pods turn brown; dry grain before storage.

name: Pigeon Pea
soil: Warm climate; performs well in well-drained black and loamy soils.
grow: Use healthy seed and suitable spacing. Intercropping with cereals or oilseeds is common.
maintain: Control weeds early, avoid standing water and monitor pod borer and wilt. Support plants in windy areas if needed.
harvest: Harvest when most pods are brown and seeds are hard.

name: Mustard
soil: Cool, dry climate and well-drained loamy soil.
grow: Sow quality seed at shallow depth with uniform spacing. Apply balanced nutrients.
maintain: Maintain moisture at flowering and pod development. Monitor aphids, white rust and alternaria.
harvest: Harvest when most siliquae turn yellow-brown but before heavy shattering.

name: Pearl Millet
soil: Hot, dry climate; tolerates lighter and sandy soils.
grow: Use drought-tolerant seed and maintain a good plant stand after rainfall.
maintain: Control weeds early and monitor shoot fly, stem borer and downy mildew. Avoid excess irrigation.
harvest: Harvest when earheads mature and grains become hard.

name: Sorghum
soil: Warm climate; adaptable to black, red and lighter soils.
grow: Sow quality seed with uniform spacing and adequate soil moisture.
maintain: Weed control is important early. Watch for shoot fly, stem borer and grain mold; avoid water stress around flowering.
harvest: Harvest mature panicles when grains are hard and dry.

name: Sugarcane
soil: Warm, sunny climate with fertile, well-drained soil and dependable water.
grow: Plant healthy setts and ensure good soil-to-sett contact. Use recommended varieties for the region.
maintain: Maintain regular irrigation, earthing-up and weed control. Monitor early shoot borer, top borer, termites and red rot.
harvest: Harvest at maturity when cane juice quality and brix are suitable.

name: Potato
soil: Cool weather and loose, well-drained fertile soil.
grow: Plant healthy certified seed tubers in raised beds or ridges with good drainage.
maintain: Keep moisture uniform and earth up plants. Monitor late blight, aphids and tuber moth.
harvest: Harvest after vines senesce and skins set; cure tubers before storage.

name: Onion
soil: Well-drained sandy loam with good organic matter and moderate climate.
grow: Use healthy seedlings and transplant at correct spacing. Avoid deep planting.
maintain: Irrigate lightly and regularly, stop irrigation before harvest, and monitor thrips and purple blotch.
harvest: Harvest when tops bend and bulbs mature; cure thoroughly in shade with ventilation.

name: Tomato
soil: Warm conditions, fertile loam and good drainage; avoid extreme heat.
grow: Raise healthy seedlings and transplant with spacing and support. Add organic matter and balanced nutrients.
maintain: Use drip irrigation where possible. Remove diseased leaves, manage weeds and scout for fruit borer, whitefly and leaf spots.
harvest: Harvest at the required maturity stage with clean picking and careful handling.

name: Chilli
soil: Warm climate and well-drained fertile soil.
grow: Transplant vigorous seedlings with good spacing and drainage.
maintain: Maintain steady moisture, avoid waterlogging and monitor thrips, mites, fruit borer and fungal leaf spots.
harvest: Harvest green fruits regularly or allow red fruits to mature fully for dry chilli.

name: Brinjal
soil: Warm climate; fertile, well-drained loam.
grow: Transplant healthy seedlings and provide support if needed.
maintain: Keep moisture uniform and fields clean. Scout closely for shoot and fruit borer, aphids and mites.
harvest: Pick tender, glossy fruits regularly to maintain production.

name: Okra
soil: Warm, sunny weather and fertile, well-drained soil.
grow: Direct sow quality seed in moist soil with proper spacing.
maintain: Keep weeds controlled and moisture uniform. Monitor jassids, whitefly, fruit borer and yellow vein mosaic symptoms.
harvest: Harvest tender pods frequently before they become fibrous.

name: Cabbage
soil: Cool season crop; fertile, moisture-retentive but well-drained soil.
grow: Raise nursery seedlings and transplant uniform plants.
maintain: Maintain consistent irrigation and scout for diamondback moth, aphids and caterpillars; avoid prolonged wet foliage.
harvest: Harvest firm heads before splitting.

name: Cauliflower
soil: Cool to mild climate; fertile, well-drained soil.
grow: Use the right maturity group for local temperature and transplant healthy seedlings.
maintain: Maintain even moisture and nutrition. Monitor diamondback moth, aphids, caterpillars and fungal diseases.
harvest: Harvest compact white curds before they loosen.

name: Cucumber
soil: Warm climate, rich soil and good drainage.
grow: Direct sow in prepared beds and provide trellis where useful.
maintain: Water regularly without waterlogging. Train vines, control weeds and monitor downy mildew, aphids and mites.
harvest: Pick young fruits frequently for better quality and continued flowering.

name: Watermelon
soil: Warm, dry weather; sandy loam with excellent drainage.
grow: Sow or transplant in warm soil with enough spacing for vine spread.
maintain: Use drip or controlled irrigation and avoid wetting foliage. Monitor aphids, mites and fruit flies.
harvest: Harvest when tendril dries near fruit, ground spot changes and fruit gives a mature sound.

name: Muskmelon
soil: Warm, dry climate and light, well-drained soil.
grow: Plant quality seed with adequate vine spacing and good drainage.
maintain: Maintain moisture during fruit set and reduce irrigation near maturity. Watch powdery mildew, aphids and fruit flies.
harvest: Harvest at full aroma, netting and easy slip stage depending on variety.

name: Banana
soil: Warm humid climate with deep, fertile, well-drained soil.
grow: Plant healthy disease-free suckers or tissue-culture plants with proper spacing.
maintain: Maintain irrigation and nutrition, remove excess suckers, support bunches and monitor pseudostem weevil and sigatoka.
harvest: Harvest mature green bunches when fingers fill and angles round out.

name: Mango
soil: Warm tropical/subtropical climate; deep, well-drained soil.
grow: Plant healthy grafted plants with adequate spacing and strong drainage.
maintain: Prune appropriately, maintain nutrition and moisture, and monitor hoppers, mealybugs, powdery mildew and fruit flies.
harvest: Harvest at physiological maturity; handle fruit carefully to reduce bruising.

name: Grapes
soil: Dry climate during fruit maturity; deep, well-drained soil and good sunlight.
grow: Train vines on a suitable trellis and prune according to variety and region.
maintain: Manage canopy, irrigation and bunch load carefully. Monitor thrips, mealybugs, powdery mildew and downy mildew.
harvest: Harvest when berries reach target colour, size, sweetness and acidity.

name: Pomegranate
soil: Hot, dry climate; well-drained soil with controlled irrigation.
grow: Use healthy grafted or rooted plants and maintain open canopy.
maintain: Regulate irrigation and nutrition, prune suckers and monitor bacterial blight, fruit borer and thrips.
harvest: Harvest when fruits reach full size and characteristic colour; avoid overripe cracking.

name: Citrus
soil: Warm subtropical conditions; fertile, well-drained soil.
grow: Plant healthy nursery material and maintain a clean basin around trees.
maintain: Provide balanced nutrition and regular irrigation. Monitor citrus psylla, leaf miner, mites, canker and gummosis.
harvest: Harvest mature fruits according to colour, size and market requirement.

name: Turmeric
soil: Warm humid climate with fertile, well-drained loam and organic matter.
grow: Plant healthy rhizomes in raised beds with adequate spacing and mulch.
maintain: Maintain moisture without waterlogging, earth up as needed and monitor rhizome rot and leaf spot.
harvest: Harvest after foliage dries and rhizomes mature; cure properly for colour and storage.

name: Ginger
soil: Warm humid climate; loose, well-drained soil rich in organic matter.
grow: Plant healthy seed rhizomes on raised beds and mulch after planting.
maintain: Keep beds moist but well drained. Monitor rhizome rot, shoot borer and leaf spot.
harvest: Harvest when leaves yellow and dry; wash and cure or process according to use.

name: Cumin
soil: Cool, dry weather and well-drained light soil.
grow: Sow clean seed in a fine, level seedbed with proper spacing.
maintain: Avoid excess irrigation and monitor wilt, blight and sucking pests. Keep weeds under control.
harvest: Harvest when plants turn yellow-brown and seeds mature, before heavy shattering.

name: Coriander
soil: Cool weather; well-drained loam with good organic matter.
grow: Use quality seed and shallow sowing. Maintain uniform plant stand.
maintain: Provide light irrigation and control weeds. Monitor aphids and fungal leaf diseases.
harvest: Harvest leaves at required stage or seeds when they turn mature green-brown.

name: Sesame
soil: Warm climate and light, well-drained soil; sensitive to waterlogging.
grow: Use clean seed and shallow sowing with adequate spacing.
maintain: Control weeds early and avoid excess moisture. Monitor phyllody, leaf spots and capsule pests.
harvest: Harvest when lower capsules turn yellow and seeds mature; dry plants before threshing.

name: Green Gram
soil: Warm climate and well-drained soil; short-duration crop.
grow: Use treated seed and maintain proper plant density.
maintain: Control weeds early, avoid waterlogging and monitor whitefly, thrips and pod borers.
harvest: Harvest pods in several pickings as they mature and dry.

name: Black Gram
soil: Warm climate and well-drained loam to black soil.
grow: Use healthy seed and sow with uniform spacing.
maintain: Keep field weed-free early and monitor yellow mosaic, whitefly, pod borer and leaf spots.
harvest: Harvest when most pods mature and turn dark; dry before threshing.

name: Peas
soil: Cool climate and fertile, well-drained soil.
grow: Sow quality seed at suitable spacing and provide support for climbing varieties.
maintain: Maintain moisture and scout for powdery mildew, rust, aphids and pod pests.
harvest: Pick green pods regularly or harvest dry peas at full maturity.

name: Tea
soil: Warm humid climate, acidic well-drained soil and regular rainfall.
grow: Plant suitable nursery bushes and maintain shade, drainage and soil organic matter.
maintain: Prune and train bushes, manage weeds and monitor tea mosquito bug, mites and blister blight.
harvest: Pluck tender shoots at the correct interval and protect harvested leaves from heat and contamination.

name: Coffee
soil: Mild tropical climate, shade and well-drained acidic soil.
grow: Use healthy seedlings with shade trees and good drainage.
maintain: Maintain shade, mulch and balanced nutrition. Monitor coffee berry borer, white stem borer and leaf rust.
harvest: Harvest ripe red cherries selectively; process quickly after picking.
